ucs.title: [LLM] Secret Blizzard (Turla) ComRAT v4 — Gmail web-UI C2 from non-browser process
ucs.description: ComRAT v4 (a.k.a. Chinch / Agent.BTZ lineage) uses the legacy Gmail HTML web interface as a covert C2 channel, polling an inbox for command emails via stolen session cookies. This UC hunts for non-browser, non-Outlook processes (PowerShell, wmiprvse, svchost-hosted, LOLBin script hosts) reaching mail.google.com or accounts.google.com — a fingerprint exclusive to Turla's ComRAT family rather than the Gmail API used by mainstream tooling.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_host IN ("mail.google.com","accounts.google.com","googleusercontent.com") OR All_Traffic.url IN ("*mail.google.com*","*accounts.google.com*")) AND All_Traffic.app IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmiprvse.exe","svchost.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe") AND NOT All_Traffic.app IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe","outlook.exe","thunderbird.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","vivaldi.exe","tor.exe") by host, All_Traffic.src, All_Traffic.user, All_Traffic.app, All_Traffic.dest_host | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe","safari.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","vivaldi.exe","tor.exe"]);
let MailClients = dynamic(["outlook.exe","thunderbird.exe","hxoutlook.exe","hxtsr.exe","communicator.exe","olk.exe"]);
let SuspectHosts = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmiprvse.exe","svchost.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("mail.google.com","accounts.google.com","googleusercontent.com")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (Browsers)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (MailClients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SuspectHosts)
   or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), Hits = count(),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), SampleUrl = any(RemoteUrl), DistinctIPs = dcount(RemoteIP)
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe","safari.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","vivaldi.exe","tor.exe"]);
let MailClients = dynamic(["outlook.exe","thunderbird.exe","hxoutlook.exe","hxtsr.exe"]);
let SuspectHosts = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmiprvse.exe","svchost.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe"]);
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where Url has_any ("mail.google.com","accounts.google.com","googleusercontent.com")
| extend Proc = tolower(tostring(split(ActingProcessName, @"\")[-1]))
| where Proc !in (Browsers)
| where Proc !in (MailClients)
| where Proc in (SuspectHosts)
   or ActingProcessName has_any (@"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Hits = count(),
            SampleUrl = any(Url), SampleCmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine)
            by DvcHostname, SrcUsername, Proc, ActingProcessName
| order by FirstSeen desc

id: 7d3c5b9e-c1c7-4b3a-9e1f-3a9c2b8a6f12
status: experimental
description: Detects non-browser/non-Mail processes connecting to Gmail web UI endpoints — the C2 channel used by Turla's ComRAT v4 (Secret Blizzard / Venomous Bear / G0010).
references:

author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
tags:

  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.t1071.003
  - attack.g0010
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_dest:
    DestinationHostname:
      - 'mail.google.com'
      - 'accounts.google.com'
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wmiprvse.exe'
      - '\svchost.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  filter_browsers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\thunderbird.exe'
      - '\msedgewebview2.exe'
  condition: selection_dest and selection_proc and not filter_browsers
falsepositives:
  - Custom automation using Gmail credentials from PowerShell
  - Backup utilities that wrap the Gmail web UI
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:3 OR @EventID:5156) @DestinationHostname:(mail.google.com OR accounts.google.com OR *.googleusercontent.com) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\wmiprvse.exe OR *\WmiPrvSE.exe OR *\svchost.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\cscript.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cmd.exe) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\brave.exe OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\thunderbird.exe OR *\msedgewebview2.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(mail\.google\.com|accounts\.google\.com|.*\.googleusercontent\.com)$/i
| ContextImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|wmiprvse|svchost|rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|cscript|wscript|cmd)\.exe$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|iexplore|opera|outlook|thunderbird|msedgewebview2|vivaldi|tor)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count(field=ContextProcessId, distinct=true, as=ProcCount))
| ProcCount >= 1
ucs.rationale: Mainstream tooling that needs Gmail uses the Gmail REST API (gmail.googleapis.com) or OAuth-mediated MAPI through Outlook — not the HTML web UI. ComRAT v4 is documented by ESET / Mandiant / Microsoft (Secret Blizzard) as polling mail.google.com directly from non-browser process contexts (often a CLR loaded by wmiprvse or a PowerShell stub) using stolen session cookies. ucs.title: [LLM] Turla (Iron Hunter) TinyTurla-NG ServiceDLL persistence outside System32
ucs.description: TinyTurla and TinyTurla-NG persist by registering as a Windows service whose ServiceDll points to a payload DLL dropped in ProgramData / Public / AppData and is then loaded by svchost.exe -k. This UC hunts for ServiceDll registry writes pointing outside %SystemRoot%\System32 / SysWOW64 and surfaces the masquerade service-name pattern Turla favors (W64Time, Sysmon, NetSetupSvc lookalikes).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\Services\\*\\Parameters\\ServiceDll" AND NOT (Registry.registry_value_data="C:\\Windows\\System32\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="%SystemRoot%\\System32\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="%SystemRoot%\\SysWOW64\\*") by host, Registry.user, Registry.process_id, Registry.process_guid, Registry.registry_path, Registry.registry_value_data | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | rex field=registry_path "\\\\Services\\\\(?<svc_name>[^\\\\]+)\\\\Parameters" | eval masquerade_hit=if(match(svc_name,"(?i)^(W64Time|w32t1me|Sysmon[A-Z0-9]?|TaskFrame|NetSetup[Ss]vc|WindowsTime[A-Z0-9]?|WSDebug|HTTPSvc|FrameworkSvc|TimeService)$"),"yes","no") | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey matches regex @"(?i)\\SYSTEM\\(CurrentControlSet|ControlSet\d+)\\Services\\[^\\]+\\Parameters$"
| where RegistryValueName =~ "ServiceDll"
| where isnotempty(RegistryValueData)
| where RegistryValueData !startswith @"C:\Windows\System32\"
    and RegistryValueData !startswith @"C:\Windows\SysWOW64\"
    and RegistryValueData !startswith @"%SystemRoot%\System32\"
    and RegistryValueData !startswith @"%SystemRoot%\SysWOW64\"
| extend SvcName = extract(@"(?i)\\Services\\([^\\]+)\\Parameters", 1, RegistryKey)
| extend MasqueradeHit = SvcName matches regex @"(?i)^(W64Time|w32t1me|Sysmon[A-Z0-9]?|TaskFrame|NetSetup[Ss]vc|WindowsTime[A-Z0-9]?|WSDebug|HTTPSvc|FrameworkSvc|TimeService)$"
| extend SuspectDropPath = RegistryValueData has_any (@"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Temp\")
| where MasqueradeHit or SuspectDropPath
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          User = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SvcName, MasqueradeHit, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
ImRegistryEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where RegistryKey matches regex @"(?i)\\SYSTEM\\(CurrentControlSet|ControlSet\d+)\\Services\\[^\\]+\\Parameters$"
| where RegistryValue =~ "ServiceDll"
| where isnotempty(RegistryValueData)
| where RegistryValueData !startswith @"C:\Windows\System32\"
    and RegistryValueData !startswith @"C:\Windows\SysWOW64\"
    and RegistryValueData !startswith @"%SystemRoot%\System32\"
    and RegistryValueData !startswith @"%SystemRoot%\SysWOW64\"
| extend SvcName = extract(@"(?i)\\Services\\([^\\]+)\\Parameters", 1, RegistryKey)
| extend MasqueradeHit = SvcName matches regex @"(?i)^(W64Time|w32t1me|Sysmon[A-Z0-9]?|TaskFrame|NetSetup[Ss]vc|WindowsTime[A-Z0-9]?|WSDebug|HTTPSvc|FrameworkSvc|TimeService)$"
| extend SuspectDropPath = RegistryValueData has_any (@"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Temp\")
| where MasqueradeHit or SuspectDropPath

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Turla TinyTurla-NG - ServiceDLL Persistence Outside System Directories
id: a2f6c0b8-2e34-45b9-9c7e-5f4e1a9d8c10
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of a Windows Service ServiceDll registry value pointing outside System32/SysWOW64 — the persistence mechanism used by Turla's TinyTurla and TinyTurla-NG implants (G0010 / Secret Blizzard).
references:
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/tinyturla-ng/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/10
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1543.003
  - attack.t1112
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0010
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetObject|contains: '\Services\'
    TargetObject|endswith: '\Parameters\ServiceDll'
  filter_system_path:
    Details|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
      - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
      - '%SystemRoot%\System32\'
      - '%SystemRoot%\SysWOW64\'
  condition: selection and not filter_system_path
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate third-party services installing DLLs in vendor directories under Program Files
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\*\Parameters\ServiceDll OR *\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\*\Parameters\ServiceDll OR *\system\currentcontrolset\services\*\parameters\servicedll) -@Details:(*\System32\* OR *\SysWOW64\* OR *\system32\* OR *\syswow64\* OR *%SystemRoot%\System32\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate RegObjectName=/\\Services\\[^\\]+\\Parameters$/i RegValueName=/^ServiceDll$/i
| NOT (RegStringValue=/^([A-Za-z]:)?\\Windows\\(System32|SysWOW64)\\/i)
| NOT (RegStringValue=/^%SystemRoot%\\(System32|SysWOW64)\\/i)
| regex("\\\\Services\\\\(?<SvcName>[^\\\\]+)\\\\Parameters", field=RegObjectName)
| MasqueradeHit := if(SvcName=/^(W64Time|w32t1me|Sysmon[A-Z0-9]?|TaskFrame|NetSetup[Ss]vc|WindowsTime[A-Z0-9]?|WSDebug|HTTPSvc|FrameworkSvc|TimeService)$/i, "yes", "no")
| SuspectPath := if(RegStringValue=/\\(ProgramData|Users\\Public|AppData|Temp)\\/i, "yes", "no")
| MasqueradeHit="yes" OR SuspectPath="yes"
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, SvcName, RegStringValue, ContextImageFileName, MasqueradeHit, SuspectPath], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Talos and Microsoft (Secret Blizzard) attribute TinyTurla and TinyTurla-NG specifically — and most other Turla service-DLL persistence (Carbon, Kazuar loaders) — to ServiceDll values pointing at DLLs dropped in ProgramData/Public/AppData, loaded by svchost -k with a service name that mimics a real Windows service (W64Time, NetSetupSvc and similar).
